# Module M-11: Read the confirmation view at the start of the day

## Lesson

You do this at the start of each day. When it works, each order shows its lines and whether it was confirmed, the day it arrived. [SC-11]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the confirmation view. [SC-11 step 1]
2. Check which of yesterday's orders were confirmed to the customer. [SC-11 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

An order not confirmed: look for its line on the exceptions list. [map/future.md item 3]
